title: The Lipschitz image of an integer-weighted bi-Lipschitz piece is an integer multiplicity current with mass ≤ Lⁿ∫|g| (supplied steps 5–7; Simon 6.3.5–3.9)
statement: Assume, as antecedents, (L3): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, every k-covector α on ℝ^N and every orthonormal family τ = (τ_0, …, τ_{k−1}) in ℝ^N, |α(τ)| ≤ |α| (covectorEuclideanNorm α); and (IMC)(b): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every IMRep R in U of dimension n and every E ⊆ ℝ^P, if U is open and E is Borel then there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' representing A with R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult and R'.orient = R.orient. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, L ≥ 0, κ > 0, let H : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz, and let B ⊆ ℝⁿ be Borel with κ·|a − a'| ≤ |H(a) − H(a')| for all a, a' ∈ B, such that H is differentiable with injective derivative at every point of B. Let g : ℝⁿ → ℤ be measurable and Lebesgue integrable on B, with g(u) ≠ 0 for every u ∈ B. Then there is an integer multiplicity current Φ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) with M(Φ) ≤ Lⁿ·∫⁻_B |g| dλ and Φ(ω) = ∫_B g(u)·ω(H(u))(DH(u)e_0, …, DH(u)e_{n−1}) du for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), where DH(u) := fderiv ℝ H u and e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1.
lean_statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (τ : Fin k → Euclid N), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (κ : ℝ) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid n → ℤ), LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet B → 0 < κ → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, κ * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → Measurable g → IntegrableOn (fun u => (g u : ℝ)) B → (∀ u ∈ B, g u ≠ 0) → ∃ Φ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity Φ ∧ Φ.mass ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * ∫⁻ u in B, ‖(g u : ℝ)‖ₑ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Φ ω = ∫ u in B, (g u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (H u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))
